steps.text: Select the top node of your scene, **$root**, in the Scene dock.
steps.why: New nodes are added as children of whatever node is selected, so we start at the top.

steps.text: Click **+** (Add Child Node), search for `Label`, and press **Create**.
steps.why: A Label is the simplest way to show text in a game.

steps.text: In the Inspector, type `Hello, Godot!` into **Text**.
steps.why: The Inspector shows every setting of the selected node; Text is what the Label displays.

steps.text: Move the label: drag it in the 2D view, or change **Position** under Layout → Transform.
steps.why: Every 2D node has a position, measured in pixels from its parent's origin.
Changes live only in the editor until you save them to the scene file.
